title: A New Heart
old_p1: Heavenly Father’s people had stopped listening to Him. Their hearts had grown hard, like a stone. You can squeeze a stone all day, and it never gets soft.
So Heavenly Father made a promise: “A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put inside you.” A new spirit means a new, good way of feeling inside.
old_p2: “I will take away the heart of stone,” He said, “and give you a heart of flesh.”
A heart of flesh is soft, warm, and alive, like your own heart beating right now. A soft heart can feel, listen, and love again. Only Heavenly Father can change a heart like that.
If your heart ever feels hard and grumpy, Heavenly Father can help it grow soft. Tonight you can let your whole body go soft and warm.
p1: Heavenly Father’s people were far from home. They had stopped listening to Him. Their hearts had grown hard, like a stone. Squeeze a stone all day, and it never gets soft.
Heavenly Father made them a promise through Ezekiel.
He said, “I will give you a new heart. I will take away the heart of stone. I will give you a soft, living heart.”
p2: A soft heart is warm and alive, like the heart beating in you. It can listen, say sorry, and love again. Heavenly Father also promised to put His Spirit inside them. It would help them do good.
When you feel grumpy, He can help. Tonight, put your hand on your heart. Say, “Heavenly Father, please give me a soft, kind heart.”
